name: Nikos
source:
Strengths - Good cook, approachable, easy going
Weaknesses - Easily scared, poor business sense

Nikos comes from the small coastal town of Stagwich, where he runs the local inn. He spends most of his time cooking and tending the 1 bar for the few customers he usually has.

His family originally came from an island off the coast of Stagwich, and he hopes to one day visit.

He's easy going, and enjoys his quiet lifestyle by the sea.
